subject: general
question: As of August 2022, the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act of which year governs the financial security, welfare and protection of senior citizens?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2007**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act was enacted in **2007**.
 
• This Act aims to ensure the financial security and welfare of senior citizens and parents.
 
• It provides a legal framework to mandate children and relatives to provide for the maintenance of senior citizens.
 
• The Act allows for the establishment of Old Age Homes and ensures proper medical facilities for senior citizens.
 
• It includes provisions for the protection of the life and property of senior citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Terminology:**

 
 
• **Maintenance:** Refers to the provision of basic necessities such as food, clothing, and healthcare.
 
• **Senior Citizen:** Defined as any person being a citizen of India, who has attained the age of sixty years or above.
 
 
 
• **Legal Obligations:**
 
 
• Children and relatives are legally obligated to provide maintenance to senior citizens and parents.
 
• Failure to comply may result in legal action and penalties.
 
 
 
• **Tribunal:**
 
 
• The Act provides for the establishment of Maintenance Tribunals to hear and decide the cases of senior citizens and parents seeking maintenance.
 
• These Tribunals have the authority to order children/relatives to provide maintenance.
 
 
 
• **Healthcare Facilities:**
 
 
• The Act mandates the provision of affordable healthcare and medical facilities for senior citizens.
 
• It also includes provisions for the establishment of Old Age Homes with appropriate medical care.
